paper text.text: The completion $H$ is nonplanar and has no $K_5$ minor. If $bd$ is present, $G-bd$ is toroidal, so $H-bd$ is planar by Corollary~\ref{r1:five-criterion}. Every $K_{3,3}$ subdivision of $H$ then uses $bd$. An allowed reduction of $B$ preserves all five attachments, so the same corollary gives a nontoroidal graph whenever the reduced completion is nonplanar. Corollary~\ref{common:reduced-forms} therefore applies with fixed edges $ab,ac,ad,ae$ and with $bd$ when present. Of the $217{,}376$ candidates, all but eight have a $K_5$ minor, a cut of at most two vertices, or a proper nontoroidal minor~\supp{E20}. The eight are isomorphic to $\mathfrak T_{20},\mathfrak T_{23},\mathfrak T_{38},\mathfrak T_{40}$ or $\mathfrak T_{69}$. In each of the last three graphs, two twin triples are disjoint or meet in two vertices. This leaves $\mathfrak T_{20}$ and $\mathfrak T_{23}$.
